statement: The proportion of mothers with any medical complications during pregnancy is higher among those whose infants experienced SUID compared to the general population of new mothers.
rationale: This study uses a case series (ncfrp_v51) for SUID cases and a population reference (prams_p7_arf) for exposure prevalence, along with a denominator source (cdc_linkco15) for live births in 2015. The design allows estimating the proportion of mothers with medical complications during pregnancy between SUID cases and the general population.
prior_art: The closest tested work is SUID_manuscript_v9_clean.C10, which excludes certain preterm infants who died early in postnatal life. This study still addresses an understudied aspect by focusing on maternal health issues related to SUID incidence.
cannot_establish: Causation, temporal relationships between maternal health issues and SUID incidence.
